/home/dns/api-alejandro/serverless.yml.serviceRawFile:
# "org" ensures this Service is used with the correct Serverless Framework Access Key.
org: batoi70
# "app" enables Serverless Framework Dashboard features and sharing them with other Services.
app: my-app
service: api-alejandro

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs18.x
  region: us-east-1
  environment:
    PRODUCTS_TABLE: ${self:service}-products-${opt:stage, 'dev'}
  iam:
    role:
      statements:
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - dynamodb:Scan
            - dynamodb:PutItem
            - dynamodb:GetItem
            - dynamodb:UpdateItem
            - dynamodb:DeleteItem
          Resource: "arn:aws:dynamodb:${opt:region, self:provider.region}:*:table/${self:provider.environment.PRODUCTS_TABLE}"

functions:
  createProduct:
    handler: handler.createProduct
    events:
      - httpApi: 'POST /products'
  getProducts:
    handler: handler.getProducts
    events:
      - httpApi: 'GET /products'
  getProductById:
    handler: handler.getProductById
    events:
      - httpApi: 'GET /products/{id}'
  updateProduct:
    handler: handler.updateProduct
    events:
      - httpApi: 'PUT /products/{id}'
  deleteProduct:
    handler: handler.deleteProduct
    events:
      - httpApi: 'DELETE /products/{id}'

resources:
  Resources:
    ProductsTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:provider.environment.PRODUCTS_TABLE}
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: id
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: id
            KeyType: HASH
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

plugins:
  - serverless-localstack

custom:
  localstack:
    stages: [dev]
    host: http://localhost
    edgePort: 4566
